zh.summary: 選出能回答核心問題的最小完整流程，保留必要的錯誤處理，並為延後與不做項目寫明理由及重新討論條件。
objectives: 以要驗證的問題決定 MVP 的範圍與完成條件。
區分第一版、延後及本版不做，保留必要的品質與安全約束。
替需求變更留下影響、決定者與重啟條件。

readingGuide.goal: 以要驗證的問題決定 MVP 的範圍與完成條件。
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md 與合成收件案例；以紙筆或文字編輯器分類，不需要新增程式。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 problem.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 新增範圍表、必要約束、完成證據及有條件的延後清單。

sections.heading: 先說明這一版要學到什麼
paragraphs: MVP（Minimum Viable Product）常被譯為最小可行產品。本課在教學原型中借用這個範圍概念：用一段最小、可操作且可驗證的流程，回答核心問題。本版不是組織正式產品的完整發行，也不把一次課堂展示當成市場或業務需求已驗證。
本課要先回答：「收件者能否在完整報告匯出前辨識並修正必要欄位缺漏？」因此輸入、缺漏提示、修正後重查、預覽與匯出互相連動。若只完成漂亮首頁，無法回答這個問題；若加入搜尋、統計與帳號，卻沒有缺件回復，也未完成本版目標。

sections.heading: 先讓一份簡餐能完整出餐
paragraphs: 測試取餐流程時，可以先只供應一種簡餐，但仍要能點餐、確認內容、處理缺貨與交付。省略整份菜單能減少範圍，省略缺貨回應則可能讓顧客付了錢卻不知道接下來怎麼辦。
軟體也可以縮小資料種類與使用情境，同時保留該情境需要的錯誤處理。本課只處理三個合成欄位、單人本機與明確缺漏規則；不因此允許缺欄位也產生「完整」報告。

sections.heading: 先驗證高風險假設，再擴充功能
paragraphs: GOV.UK 的 alpha 指南把原型用於測試最具風險的假設；discovery 指南則允許根據了解的限制，決定繼續、改變方向或停止。本課採用這個「以證據決定下一步」的方法，不將英國服務階段、時間或行政要求當成臺灣課程的規定。
在合成收件案例中，可先問：必要欄位是否有明確規則？缺件提示是否足以讓人自行修正？若規則負責人尚未確認欄位，增加模型功能不會消除規則不明的風險。先保留問題，決定是暫用教學規則演練，還是等待確認後才處理正式流程。

sections.heading: 將需求分成三種範圍狀態
paragraphs: 第一版是本次要驗收的工作；延後是仍可能需要、但必須符合啟動條件才納入；本版不做是明確排除的責任或能力。這是本課的記錄方式，不是宣稱所有團隊都採相同分類。
「多人共用」若延後，應寫明要重新訪談角色、確認資料隔離及保存，再設計驗證。不能因為原型可從另一台電腦連到就宣稱共用系統已完成。任何與真實資料、正式受理或權限相關的變更，都需重新檢視原本邊界。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜三種範圍狀態
blocks.description: 卡片是並列分類，不是所有項目最終都會依序上線。

items.title: 第一版
items.body: 合成欄位輸入、缺漏提示、補齊重查、當次預覽與匯出；以案例與任務操作驗收。

items.title: 延後
items.body: 多人共用與歷史查詢：先確認角色、資料責任與需求，再決定是否進入設計。

items.title: 本版不做
items.body: 正式受理、真實個資與自動對外寄送：本教學原型不承擔這些責任。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜範圍決定要能說明理由
rows: 欄位缺漏後的修正與重查
沒有這條路徑就無法完成核心任務
完整報告對應目前輸入
避免修改後仍匯出舊結果，不能當裝飾功能刪除
先確認查詢目的、保存及刪除規則，再估計成本
另確認角色及授權、資料儲存與維運，再建立驗證計畫
屬另一項業務責任；若日後提出，需重新定義專案及驗收

sections.heading: 新增功能時同時談取捨與驗證
paragraphs: 假設同儕提出「順便做批次匯入」。先問一次要處理多少筆、每筆缺件如何回報、部分失敗怎麼復原、是否仍要逐筆預覽。這些回答可能改變資料模型與介面，不能只以「多一個按鈕」估算。
把這項要求寫成候選變更，列出受影響的流程、規格與測試，請範圍負責角色決定納入、交換掉其他工作或延後。時數固定時，取捨應可見；不要默默刪除負向情境來讓新增功能看起來做得完。

sections.heading: 用完成條件守住最小完整流程
paragraphs: 展示能點開網頁只能證明啟動。本版至少需用缺件、補齊與修改後重查案例，證明匯出限制與輸入一致；再請試用者完成一項指定任務，記錄提示與恢復是否清楚。功能證據與易用性觀察分開保留。
常見誤解是「MVP 可以先不管安全」。可以選擇不收真實資料、不連外或不做共用，縮小責任與風險；但已納入的資料處理與匯出限制仍要遵守。若無法做到核心約束，就留下缺口並停止宣稱該任務已完成。

blocks.heading: problem.md 範圍與重啟條件
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 problem.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 本版範圍（合成原型）
核心問題：匯出前能否發現並修正必要欄位缺漏？
第一版：輸入、檢查、補齊重查、當次預覽、完整匯出
必要約束：缺件不得完整匯出；修改後舊結果失效
延後：歷史查詢；先確認查詢目的與保存／刪除規則
延後：十人共用；先確認角色、隔離、儲存、維運與驗證
本版不做：正式受理、真實個資、自動對外通知
完成證據：缺件／補齊／修改後重查案例及任務觀察
新增要求：先記影響與取捨，由範圍負責角色確認
待確認：哪個假設若不成立，就應修改或停止這個設計？

exercise.environment: problem.md 與合成收件案例；以紙筆或文字編輯器分類，不需要新增程式。
steps: 寫出本版要回答的一個核心問題，從輸入到結果選出最小完整流程。
將批次匯入、歷史查詢、十人共用與正式通知分到第一版、延後或本版不做，逐項寫理由。
替每個延後項目寫啟動條件，再用缺件及修改後重查兩種情境核對核心約束沒有被刪除。
exercise.expected: problem.md 新增範圍表、必要約束、完成證據及有條件的延後清單。
exercise.check: 第一版可完成核心任務且有失敗回復；新增功能不會自動啟用延後責任；每項取捨可說明。
exercise.cleanup: 保留未納入項目的理由與重新討論條件，不將延後清單改成已承諾的發布排程。

en.summary: Select a minimum complete flow that answers the core question, retain necessary error handling, and explain exclusions, deferrals and conditions for reconsideration.
objectives: Define MVP scope and completion conditions from the question to verify.
Distinguish first-version work, deferred work and exclusions while retaining necessary quality and security constraints.
Record impacts, decision owners and conditions for reopening requirement changes.

readingGuide.goal: Define MVP scope and completion conditions from the question to verify.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md and the synthetic intake case. Classify work on paper or in a text editor; no code additions are needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the scenario and principles, compare examples, then expand problem.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A scope table, necessary constraints, completion evidence and conditional deferrals in problem.md.

sections.heading: State What This Version Needs to Establish
paragraphs: MVP means Minimum Viable Product. This course borrows the scope concept for a teaching prototype: a minimum operable, verifiable flow that answers a core question. It is not a full organizational product release, and one classroom demonstration does not validate market or business demand.

The first question is whether intake workers can identify and correct missing required fields before exporting a complete report. Input, feedback, correction and rechecking, preview and export therefore work together. A polished home page cannot answer it. Search, statistics and accounts without recovery from missing input do not meet this version’s goal either.

sections.heading: Deliver One Complete Meal Before Expanding the Menu
paragraphs: To test a meal-collection flow, offer only one meal while retaining ordering, confirmation, handling unavailable items and delivery. Reducing menu choice narrows scope. Omitting out-of-stock feedback can leave paying customers uncertain what happens next.

Software can likewise restrict data types and situations while retaining the errors that situation needs handled. This course uses three synthetic fields, one local user and explicit missing-input rules. A missing field still must not produce a report marked complete.

sections.heading: Test Risky Assumptions Before Adding Features
paragraphs: GOV.UK’s alpha guidance uses prototypes to test the riskiest assumptions; discovery guidance allows continuing, changing direction or stopping based on understood constraints. The course adopts evidence-based decisions without treating UK service phases, schedules or administrative requirements as rules for this Taiwan-based course.

For the synthetic case, ask whether required-field rules are explicit and feedback lets people correct omissions independently. If the rule owner has not confirmed fields, adding model features cannot resolve that uncertainty. Retain the question and decide whether to practice with teaching rules or await confirmation before working on an official process.

sections.heading: Record Three Scope States
paragraphs: First-version work is what will be accepted now. Deferred work may be needed but requires activation conditions before inclusion. Excluded work defines responsibilities or capabilities outside this version. These are the course’s recording categories, not a universal team standard.

Deferring shared use should include new role interviews, isolation and retention requirements, then verification design. Access from another computer does not establish a completed shared system. Changes involving real data, official acceptance or permissions require revisiting the original boundary.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Scope States
blocks.description: These are parallel categories, not stages through which every item will eventually be released.

items.title: First version
items.body: Synthetic input, missing-field feedback, correction and rechecking, current preview and export; accept through cases and task operation.

items.title: Deferred
items.body: Shared use and historical queries: confirm roles, data responsibilities and needs before deciding whether to design them.

items.title: Excluded from this version
items.body: Official acceptance, actual personal data and automatic external messages are outside this teaching prototype’s responsibilities.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Explain Scope Decisions
rows: The core task cannot finish without this path.
Prevent stale exports after edits; this is not a decorative feature to remove.
Confirm purpose, retention and deletion rules before estimating cost.
Sharing and isolation for ten users
Confirm roles, authorization, storage and operations, then establish verification.
A separate business responsibility; redefine the project and acceptance if requested later.

sections.heading: Discuss Trade-offs and Verification for New Features
paragraphs: If a peer asks to “also add batch import,” clarify batch size, per-record missing-input feedback, partial-failure recovery and whether each record still needs preview. Answers may change the data model and interface; “one extra button” is not a sufficient estimate.

Record a proposed change with affected flows, specifications and tests. Ask the scope owner to include it, exchange other work for it or defer it. With fixed teaching time, make trade-offs visible. Do not quietly remove negative scenarios to make the addition appear feasible.

sections.heading: Use Completion Conditions to Retain a Complete Flow
paragraphs: Opening a web page demonstrates startup only. Use missing-input, completed-input and post-edit recheck cases to establish export restrictions and input consistency. Ask a participant to perform a specified task and record whether feedback and recovery are clear. Retain functional evidence and usability observations separately.

A common mistake is assuming an MVP can ignore security. Reduce responsibility and risk by excluding real data, networking or shared use. Still follow the processing and export constraints included in scope. If a core constraint cannot be met, record the gap and stop claiming that task is complete.

blocks.heading: Scope and Reopening Conditions for problem.md
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the core question, first-version flow, missing-input/stale-result constraints, conditional deferrals for history and ten-user sharing, exclusions, evidence, change ownership and a question about when to revise or stop. Adapt it for the class; it is not an actual business rule or finding.

exercise.environment: problem.md and the synthetic intake case. Classify work on paper or in a text editor; no code additions are needed.
steps: Write one core question for this version and select a minimum complete flow from input to outcome.
Classify batch import, historical queries, sharing with ten users and official notifications as first-version, deferred or excluded, explaining each decision.
Give each deferred item activation conditions, then use missing-input and post-edit recheck situations to verify that core constraints remain.
exercise.expected: A scope table, necessary constraints, completion evidence and conditional deferrals in problem.md.

exercise.cleanup: Retain exclusion reasons and reconsideration conditions. Do not turn deferred work into a promised release schedule.

zh.prompt: 本課第一版最適合採哪種範圍？
options: 所有產業流程與帳號一次完成
只有首頁與漂亮按鈕
一段含輸入、缺漏回復、預覽與當次匯出的完整流程
先匯出任何內容，錯誤以後再管
rationales: 過大的範圍難以在課堂驗證核心問題。
外觀與核心工作是否完成是不同事情。
範圍小，但能以案例驗證一項工作結果。
核心約束不能因為名為 MVP 就省略。

en.prompt: Which scope best fits this course’s first version?
options: Complete every industry workflow and account system at once.
Only a home page and attractive buttons.
A complete flow including input, missing-data recovery, preview and export matching current input.
Export anything now and handle errors later.
rationales: Excessive scope makes the core question difficult to verify in class.
Appearance and completion of the work are different matters.
The scope is small but cases can verify one work outcome.
Calling it an MVP does not remove core constraints.

zh.prompt: 「十人共用」目前延後，什麼才是合理啟動條件？
options: 把伺服器網址傳給十個人
Agent 說自己可以做到
介面看起來簡潔
確認角色、資料隔離、保存與維運要求，重新設計驗證後決定
rationales: 能連線不代表資料權限正確。
能力宣告不是需求及驗證證據。
簡潔介面不能代替共用架構。
共用改變責任與風險，需要新的需求與證據。

en.prompt: Sharing with ten users is deferred. What is a reasonable activation condition?
options: Send the server URL to ten people.
The agent says it can do it.
The interface looks simple.
Confirm roles, isolation, retention and operations, then redesign verification before deciding.
rationales: Connectivity does not establish correct data permissions.
A capability claim is not requirements or verification evidence.
Interface simplicity cannot replace shared-system design.
Sharing changes responsibilities and risks, requiring new requirements and evidence.

zh.prompt: 時數固定又新增批次匯入要求，應怎麼做？
options: 記錄需求影響與取捨，請範圍負責角色決定是否納入或延後
悄悄刪掉缺件測試換時間
只在 README 寫已支援
把延後清單全部標成完成
rationales: 可見的決策能使流程、規格與測試一致。
刪除核心驗證會隱藏缺口。
文件宣稱不能代替實作。
狀態應依實際證據維護。

en.prompt: Teaching time is fixed and batch import is requested. What should happen?
options: Record impacts and trade-offs for the scope owner to decide inclusion or deferral.
Quietly delete missing-input tests to save time.
Write “supported” only in README.
Mark every deferred item complete.
rationales: Visible decisions keep flow, specification and tests consistent.
Removing core verification hides gaps.
A documentation claim does not implement a feature.
Maintain status from actual evidence.
